gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed diagnosis of WHO grade IV glioblastoma (including variants such as gliosarcoma, giant cell glioblastoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] Device :DaRT seeds: The sources are impregnated with a layer containing Ra-224 which is well fixated to the surface of the source.
Recurrent Glioblastoma; Brachytherapy; GBM; Alpha DaRT sources; Intratumoral Diffusing Alpha Emitters

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Alpha Radiation Emitters Device (DaRT) for the Treatment of Recurrent Glioblastoma

coder_notes: Intervention is a registered device: Ra-224 diffusing alpha-emitter brachytherapy seeds (DaRT) implanted intratumorally. Treated as a device/radiotherapy (brachytherapy), not a radiopharmaceutical drug, so no agent row and no candidate; adjudicator may consider whether Ra-224 seeds should count as a radiopharmaceutical. 'WHO grade IV glioblastoma' with giant cell glioblastoma variant and no IDH requirement coded historical. Registered phase NA.
